quarterly_data.quarter: All Ring Tech IR presentation: MOPS 618720260826E003 (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Deck (core technology): five core technologies support advanced-process applications: automation (loader / unloader, carrier transfer, lane change); precision dispensing (underfill, flux jetting, silver paste, heatsink); attachment (flex, PSA, OCA, film TIM, metal TIM, PI film); optical inspection (post-die bond, post-dispenser, post-bumping, AOI); and CPO opto-electronic integration (coupling, protection, cleaning, inspection), with capability extending from single-station equipment to process, inspection and automation integration.
